Interface BookstoreAPI

All Known Implementing Classes:
ArrayListBookstore, FixedArrayBookstore
public interface BookstoreAPI
Insertion-ordered, ISBN-unique catalogue; implementations are not thread-safe.

Null arguments are rejected. Invalid ISBN syntax and blank search text are rejected rather than treated as misses. Snapshots are detached. A duplicate add preserves the original entry. This is a catalogue, not a stock counter.

    • add

      boolean add(Book book)
      Adds an entry if absent. Duplicate detection is O(n).
      Parameters:
      book - nonnull entry
      Returns:
      true if added, false for an existing ISBN
      Throws:
